name: @availkit/client
description: Official TypeScript client for the AvailKit Booking API

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts --target=browser --format=esm --packages=bundle --outfile=./dist/index.js && bunx tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --declarationMap false --outDir dist --rootDir src --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --target ES2022 --lib ES2022,DOM,DOM.Iterable --strict --skipLibCheck src/index.ts
